pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp-to-moderate pixel gradients along the edges; larger, elongated patches are visible on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the neck and lower leg regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, light-colored negative space forming a web-like topological graph; junctions are primarily tri-radiate nodes with consistent pixel thickness across the torso, though pathways narrow as they approach the limb extremities.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane displays a continuous jagged silhouette with low-to-medium amplitude and consistent frequency along the cervical and thoracic dorsal ridge.
